about: The calendar date each vendored measurement was TAKEN, in the operator's local time (UTC-7, where every harness below ran). descriptor-mnemonic's scripts/vendor-coord-evidence.sh reads measured_at from here and refuses an input file with no entry. A sidecar rather than a field in each file: these files are raw harness output, byte-compared by the gates that produce them (scripts/liana-live-gate.sh diffs liana-live-gate-expected.jsonl; f449-stage4/liana-probes.sh re-runs byte-identical), so a date cannot be written into them. Not the commit time: F-674 item 3, a 20:09 local commit became 2026-09-24 in UTC. A record committed later than the rest of its file gets its own date under records, keyed by name. basis says where the date comes from.
